units.source_text: 「如果有酒的話，我倒想喝一點。

en.t: If there is any sake, I would rather like a little to drink.

units.source_text: 人生恰似水流動，人生恰似……不對，是流水恰似人生過。」

en.t: Life is just like flowing water, life is just like... no, it is flowing water that is just like life passing by.

units.source_text: 我一邊哼唱著，一邊讓靜子幫我脫衣，額頭貼在她的胸前睡去。

en.t: As I hummed the song, I let Shizuko undress me and fell asleep with my forehead pressed against her chest.

units.source_text: 明天也做相同的事只要堅守昨日的慣例

en.t: Tomorrow, too, I would do the same thing, so long as I held fast to yesterday's routine.

units.source_text: 迴避極度的狂喜巨大的傷悲就不會悄然而至

en.t: If I avoided extreme ecstasy, great sorrow would not quietly steal upon me.

units.source_text: 躲開阻擋去路的石頭癩蛤蟆繞路爬行

en.t: The toad crawls around the stone that blocks its path.

units.source_text: 當我讀到上田敏翻譯的夏爾·克羅的這首詩時，羞紅的臉如同燃燒的火。

en.t: When I read this poem by Charles Cros in Ueda Bin's translation, my face flushed as red as fire.

units.source_text: 世人原諒我，還是不原諒我；

en.t: Whether the world forgives me or refuses to forgive me;

units.source_text: 世人遺忘我，還是不遺忘我都無所謂。

en.t: whether the world forgets me or refuses to forget me, it makes no difference.
